review:
A 243-ways heist built around Sticky Mystery Prizes. Three scatters give 10 free spins, four give 10 Super Free Spins, and in both the scatters become mystery prizes that lock in place.

They only reveal when four or more are on screen: cash from 0.1x to 20x, or the Mini (25x), Minor (50x), Major (250x) and Grand. Super Free Spins raise the minimum prize to 1x. Medium-high volatility, a 2,000x max and an excellent 97.12% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.12% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
